meta.description: ADS-PRE correctness and coalition exposure (self-contained, diagnostic)

results.establishes: published V2 Alg.8 'D/Omega' with Omega a POINT is undefined (expected False)
results.not_established: nothing about V1; this is the V2 typing error only

results.establishes: V2 Dec2 does NOT recover omega (expected False): it recovers H4(omega)
V2 Dec2 recovers H4(omega), a hash that cannot be inverted to omega

results.not_established: recovery of Phi_j, d_j, or the signing secret s_j individually (see C1-c)

results.establishes: recovered x_j decrypts a fresh, never-delegated first-level ciphertext addressed to j
results.not_established: any effect on ciphertexts addressed to other receivers

results.establishes: the algebraic identity s_j = x_j + Phi_j*(1 - H2) holds (verified on this instance)
results.not_established: it does NOT by itself prove s_j is hard to recover. Rearranged, Phi_j = (s_j - x_j)/(1 - H2) requires H2 != 1 (else undefined) and knowledge of s_j; from the coalition view (x_j and the public (Phi_j+d_j)P) obtaining Phi_j is an ECDL instance. Whether the FULL adversary view yields s_j is a separate claim needing a proof, not shown here.

detail.condition: H2 != 1 for the rearrangement to be defined

results.establishes: proxy+delegatee+KGC (adds d_j) recover Phi_j, hence the full private key (Phi_j,d_j)
results.not_established: this needs the KGC in the coalition; without d_j it is the ECDL of C1-c

results.establishes: both tampered records still pass the per-item cloud f-check
the aggregate theta-check ACCEPTS the batch though neither theta is individually valid
neither individual theta verifies: the sum cancelled the tampering
a replayed record is accepted again inside a later aggregate (no freshness bound)
dropping a record and its theta still verifies (no completeness bound)
